title: Monday
summary: A familiar day name with a much older story hidden inside.
question: Where did Monday get its name?
completion: Monday keeps an older English Moon-day name. Its calendar idea came from a Roman Moon-day tradition. German Montag is a cousin; Italian lunedì keeps the Latin sounds more clearly.
partner: A similar sound is a clue. Let’s check the evidence.
